instruction: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, open the Service NSW website. Search for "Forms in PDF format". From the list of PDF links, click "Letter of Authority - PDF" and download the PDF to the Desktop.
gt_steps: Navigate to the Service NSW website.
Search for Forms in PDF format.
Open the list of PDF forms.
Find and click Letter of Authority - PDF.
Save the downloaded PDF to the Desktop.

result.command: powershell -Command "if (Get-ChildItem -Path 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop' -Filter '*.pdf' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'Letter|Authority|letter|authority' }) { Write-Output 'PDF_FOUND' } else { Write-Output 'PDF_NOT_FOUND' }"
